checks.name: first open, nothing set: no dash animation runs (class, computed animation and Web Animations)
first open: dataflow edges keep their dashes and arrows; calls stay solid (bridges to collapsed groups keep their own style)
default: pan moves the view and wheel zoom zooms
legacy set by name: the dataflow dashes move again
legacy and the default draw every edge the same apart from motion (stroke, width, dashes, opacity, arrow)
switching live: safe and the removed key stop the motion; legacy starts it
an invalid value ("Safe", "LEGACY", 42, "") falls back to safe, not legacy
after a webview reload: legacy still moves, and with nothing set nothing moves
nothing set, a Param Flow highlighted: the relation is drawn highlighted (colour, width, dashes, arrow, label), and nothing moves
export, nothing set: the SVG has static dashes, arrows and the highlight; no animation; the JPG is an image
export keeps the viewport, the selection and the highlight
